EXP29871.verdict: Legend line only; data in ImmPort, not in the paper
EXP29871.comment: Paper side: the only mention is one legend line in the supplement spreadsheet (Supplementary Table 1, row 20): 'Plasma anti-S1-IgG and IgM levels. OD450 values for ELISA.' The spreadsheet has no anti-S1 data column under it, the supplement has no methods section, and the main text describes no anti-S1 ELISA (it only says controls were negative 'by RT-qPCR and serology'). ImmPort side: the assay was run for this study and its data are deposited: 177 IgG results from 112 subjects, in OD450, the same unit as the legend. The agent had no method text to extract.
